description.value: The study compared executive and social cognition profiles and structural neuroimaging in behavioral variant frontotemporal dementia, elderly bipolar disorder, and healthy controls, using voxel-based morphometry and brain-behavior analyses.

spans.text: The aim of the present study was to compare the executive functions (EF) and social cognition profiles as well as the structural neuroimaging of bvFTD and elderly patients with BD.

description.value: A non-interventional, cross-sectional comparison of patients with bvFTD and elderly BD and healthy controls.

spans.text: Previous research has characterized bvFTD and late-life BD independently, but little comparisons of these pathologies have been made from neuropsychological and neuroanatomical perspectives.
Patients were included only if they showed frontal or temporal atrophy on MRI.
